personality: Structure of 4 Tactile / Playful with Color/Typography of 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal
personality_one_liner: An earthy, tactile, and highly accessible marketplace celebrating Indian heritage and empowering rural artisans through extreme simplicity.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing and oversized tap targets (minimum 56pt) are critical for rural accessibility. Ensure chunky padding inside cards.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary for sticky headers or bottom tabs to maintain high contrast and clarity for elderly/non-tech users.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. It reduces readability and contrast for rural/non-tech users.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Language selection and Role selection (Buyer vs. Artisan) using large, highly visual tap areas.

states.error: Clear text alert with 'Try Again' button.

screens.layout: Linear navigation wizard. First screen: Language selection grid (Devanagari, Tamil, etc.). Second screen: Split layout with two massive cards ('I want to Buy', 'I want to Sell') utilizing photos and iconography. Touch targets must be massive.

screens.name: BuyerHome
screens.purpose: A visually rich, story-driven feed showcasing featured artisans and craft categories.

states.empty: Illustration of a marketplace with text 'No crafts found' and a 'Refresh' button.
states.error: Error message with an oversized 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top: Sticky search bar. Next: Horizontal scrolling pill filters for categories (Pottery, Textiles, etc.). Body: Large hero cards featuring artisan photos (not just products). Cards use progressive reveal storytelling—showing the artisan working, with a gradient scrim at the bottom containing the title and 'View Story' CTA.

screens.name: ProductDetail
screens.purpose: Showcase the product, tell the artisan's story, and facilitate WhatsApp contact.
screens.layout: Top half: Edge-to-edge product carousel. Bottom half: Large, legible text block detailing the craft's story, origin, and the artisan's profile. At the bottom root: Sticky 'Contact Seller on WhatsApp' CTA (brandPrimary) filling the width with safe area clearance.

screens.name: ArtisanDashboard
screens.purpose: Extremely simple hub for the artisan to manage listings and see inquiries.

states.empty: Illustration of empty shelf with 'Add your first craft' CTA.

screens.layout: Minimalist grid. Top: Massive 'Add Product using AI Magic' card spanning full width. Below: Large list items for 'My Crafts' and 'Messages'. Avoid complex metrics; use simple conversational status (e.g., '3 people asked about this').

screens.name: AIProductScanner
screens.purpose: Step-by-step camera upload flow where AI auto-extracts product details to eliminate typing.

states.loading: Lottie animation of 'AI analyzing photo' with text 'Creating your product story...'
states.error: Couldn't detect product. 'Retake Photo' primary button.

screens.layout: Capture Flow: Camera viewfinder with an overlay guide. Once snapped, AI extraction results appear in a chunked, easy-to-read list (Generated Name, Suggested Price, Story). Large 'Confirm' or 'Edit with Voice' buttons. Voice input is prioritized over text fields.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design with extreme accessibility in mind: minimum touch targets of 56pt, large base font size (16pt), and high contrast (7:1).
Disable glassmorphism completely. Use solid, earthy tones (surfaceSecondary/surfaceTertiary) to maintain legibility for non-tech-savvy users.
Implement the 'Sticky CTA' pattern on scrollable screens, specifically the WhatsApp contact button on the Buyer's product detail page.
Whenever placing text over images (like on the artisan hero cards), MUST use a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee readability.
Prioritize visual storytelling over data grids: use large photos of artisans and products.
For the artisan flow, replace standard forms with AI-assisted voice and photo uploads. Use oversized pill buttons for interactions.
Ensure the typography scale caters well to regional Indian languages (Devanagari, Tamil, etc.) with proper line heights.
Use Phosphor icons filled/outlined uniformly, avoiding any complex SVGs or emojis in the UI.
